title: Kula Today
heading: Today · Tue 10 Nov
summary: A light day (forecast light). Thermals stayed light all day. The upslope ran from about 09:00 to about 15:30. The evening before, the page called it normal, about 5,000 ft, a hit. Midday the base averaged about 5,300 ft by the Kekoa camera, 300 ft higher than the evening's number; the morning update said about 5,300 ft and was right on; at 10:00, from the 09:00 base, about 5,500 ft, off by 200 ft. Most of the day the shear line was crossing Kula Highway near Omaopio; furthest north about 10:22, crossing Kula Highway near Kamehameha Schools; furthest south about 16:50, crossing Kula Highway at the middle Lower Kula Road junction. Data gaps: no readings all day from 1 station (Nakula); Kahikinui stopped at 08:50; Upper Kahikinui stopped at 10:45; the Mesonet could not be reached on 10 of 58 updates.
